name: Lazio
summary: A sky-blue field with 'Regione Lazio' in gold and the regional arms: a gold-edged octagon holding the arms of its five provinces, between laurel and olive branches and under a gold crown.
origin: The arms place the province of Rome at the centre, with Frosinone, Latina, Rieti and Viterbo around it.

symbols.name: Octagon
symbols.description: A gold-edged octagon with provincial arms.
symbols.meaning: The five provinces united in one region.

facts: Rome, Italy's capital, is in Lazio.
The name comes from Latium, home of the ancient Latins.
clues: An octagon of provincial arms under a crown, on sky blue with gold lettering.
